summary.intent: Enable and test the auto-summarize feature in Entire to automatically generate AI-written outcome summaries at commit time.
summary.outcome: Auto-summarize was enabled in settings and a test commit was made, but the outcome was not auto-generated because Entire's summarize feature requires spawning a nested `claude` CLI process, which is blocked inside an active Claude Code session.

repo: The `entire explain --commit <sha>` command shows checkpoint metadata (ID, session, tokens, intent, outcome, transcript) linked via the `Entire-Checkpoint` git trailer.
Outcome generation requires the `claude` CLI and must be run outside of an active Claude Code session due to nested session restrictions.

code.finding: Added `strategy_options.summarize.enabled: true` to enable auto-summarize on commit.

workflow: Entire's `manual-commit` strategy injects `Entire-Checkpoint` trailers into commit messages automatically via git hooks.
Outcome summaries can be generated on-demand with `entire explain --checkpoint <id> --generate`, or regenerated with `--force`.
Running `entire explain --checkpoint <id> --generate` must be done from a terminal outside of Claude Code to avoid nested session conflicts.

friction: Auto-summarize silently fails inside a Claude Code session — Entire cannot spawn a nested `claude` CLI process, and no error is surfaced during commit.
The failure mode for auto-summarize is non-obvious: the outcome field just shows `(not generated)` with no indication of why.
open_items: Verify that auto-summarize works correctly when committing from a regular terminal outside of Claude Code.
Investigate whether Entire could surface a warning or fallback when the `claude` CLI cannot be spawned during commit-time summarization.
